name: gate_context_line_inside_hunk
about: The consequence shows on an unchanged line inside the hunk. The platform accepts a comment there, so the location check must too -- being stricter would discard good findings.
diff:
diff --git a/net.py b/net.py
--- a/net.py
+++ b/net.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def parse_port(value):
     port = int(value)
-    if port < 0 or port > 65535:
+    if port < 0:
         raise ValueError(value)
     return port

findings.title: Ports above 65535 are now returned unvalidated
